decisions.rationale: Probe extreme points and high-impact rewrites: full SET_BASED across all loops to test minimum buffer gets, and pure caching with moderate bulk arrays to explore balanced memory-IO trade-offs.
LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically cuts f1 at high memory. Testing SET_BASED with BULK and caching individually explores whether cache memory is shared or duplicated, seeking balanced Pareto trade-offs.
Evaluating BULK_500 for s1/s3 paired with SET_BASED for s5 to minimize f1, while testing LOOKUP_CACHE versus SQL and lower bulk sizes to map the memory frontier.
Evaluating configurations that selectively cache one lookup table while keeping the other SQL-based or testing BULK_50 on low-memory paths to discover intermediate trade-offs between f1 and f2.
Test caching on s2 only with BULK_500/SET_BASED, which drastically lowers gets while avoiding s4 cache overhead, and probe BULK_5000 combinations to refine the lowest gets frontier.
Test lower PGA boundaries with ROW and BULK_50 combinations when s2/s4 use LOOKUP_CACHE, and probe SET_BASED with BULK_50 on s3 to find memory-buffer trade-offs around 15MB.
Test lower PGA frontiers: ROW/BULK_5000 combinations with LOOKUP_CACHE, and evaluate if LOOKUP_CACHE on s4 alone with ROW at s1 achieves lower f2 below 14976KB.
Test BULK_5000 on s1 with BULK_500 on s3/s5, and explore cache configurations with lower memory footprint around ROW/BULK_50 combinations.
Eval 38 achieved the lowest PGA (1984KB). Exploring variations of s3/s1 set-based combinations without cache can push the low-PGA frontier and refine intermediate trade-offs.
Evaluating intermediate PGA regimes where s2 uses LOOKUP_CACHE and s4 uses LOOKUP_SQL with s1/s3 set to ROW or low BULK to uncover missing Pareto trade-offs.
Explore pure set-based processing to minimize logical reads, alongside balanced bulk processing with cached lookups to map out memory versus I/O trade-offs across all loops.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces f1 at high memory cost. Testing BULK with LOOKUP_SQL and smaller limit sizes, or partial caching, balances buffer gets against session memory without incurring maximum cache overhead.
LOOKUP_CACHE achieves massive f1 drops while SET_BASED at s5 minimizes memory. We probe combinations of SET_BASED with caching and smaller bulk limits to balance logical reads and PGA.
Test BULK_5000 with SET_BASED s5 to find global minimum f1, and explore mixed cache configurations (s2=LOOKUP_SQL with s4=LOOKUP_CACHE) to identify intermediate memory-IO tradeoffs.
Test BULK_5000 on s1/s3 to push f1 lower, explore BULK_50/ROW on s5, and evaluate asymmetric bulk sizes under LOOKUP_CACHE.
Test caching only in s2 (with SET_BASED s3) or mixed low-bulk configurations to search for intermediate memory/buffer trade-offs between 2304KB and 15232KB.
Test caching only s2 while keeping s3/s4 in SQL/SET_BASED, and probe combinations around ROW/SET_BASED with single caches to bridge the gap between low PGA (2.3MB) and high PGA (15MB).
Test caching on s2 only while keeping s3 set-based or low-memory SQL to explore intermediate memory regimes between 2.3MB and 15MB.
Evaluating ROW on S1/S3 combined with SET_BASED and cache variations to map low-memory borders, plus testing BULK_5000 on S1 with cache and SET_BASED S5 to push minimal f1.
Testing ROW for s1 with SET_BASED s3, plus single cache configurations to probe low PGA trade-offs.
Test full SET_BASED across all loops for minimal I/O, then explore moderate BULK sizes and lookup caching to map trade-offs between buffer gets and session PGA.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically cuts f1 at high memory cost. Testing BULK_5000 with cache pushes minimum f1, while pairing one cache lookup with SET_BASED or lower bulk sizes explores the intermediate trade-off frontier.
Test combinations of BULK_5000 and SET_BASED across s1/s3/s5 with LOOKUP_CACHE to push f1 lower, and test single-cache configurations to explore the memory trade-off between 2.3MB and 15MB.
Test only one cache lookup (s2 vs s4) with SET_BASED/ROW combinations to find intermediate memory trade-offs between 2304KB and 15232KB.
Test isolating single lookup caches with SET_BASED or SQL lookups to find low-memory trade-offs between 2304KB and 15000KB, plus test BULK_500 on s1 with BULK_5000 on s3.
Test low-memory alternatives around eval #22 (f2=1984KB) with BULK collect without cache, and refine the Pareto front between f1=3549 and f2=15MB.
Test single-cache configurations and ROW variants on s5 to find lower memory trade-offs or further refine the low-f1 region.
Evaluating ROW on s1/s3 with s5 alternatives to explore the minimal-memory frontier below 1984KB, plus testing whether non-SET_BASED s5 can reduce baseline memory further.

Test low-memory set-based and row combinations around the Pareto frontier at f2=1920-2304KB, exploring whether intermediate bulk levels or specific unabsorbed lookups lower PGA or buffer gets without lookup caching.
Test BULK_5000 with ROW and investigate caching in S2 alone versus S1/S3 combinations to explore tight f1-f2 trade-off gaps near the Pareto frontier.
Test SET_BASED across loops to explore the low-gets boundary, alongside BULK and LOOKUP_CACHE combinations to observe memory versus I/O trade-offs across distinct loop sites.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically cuts logical I/O at high PGA cost. Combining BULK_50 with LOOKUP_CACHE, and testing asymmetric cache/bulk setups, will explore intermediate memory-I/O trade-offs between the set-based and high-memory bulk configurations.

Combining s1/s3 bulk processing with LOOKUP_CACHE and s5=SET_BASED achieved the lowest f1 (3556). Testing BULK_5000 and BULK_50 under this template, plus isolating cache combinations, explores the low-gets Pareto boundary.

Evaluating single cache vs double cache to isolate PGA overhead and check if s2 caching without s4 (or vice versa) yields intermediate trade-offs between f1 ~21k and f2 ~15MB. Also test BULK s5 with SET s1/s3.
Test s5=ROW with best lookup caching and bulk configurations to evaluate if low PGA can be attained without sacrificing the massive logical read reduction achieved via LOOKUP_CACHE.
Explore low-memory configurations using combinations of ROW or BULK_50/500 without LOOKUP_CACHE, and evaluate if LOOKUP_CACHE can pair with ROW or SET_BASED to discover intermediate memory/IO points.
Test single LOOKUP_CACHE combined with SET_BASED to discover intermediate memory/IO trade-offs, and check BULK_5000 f1 lower bound with SET_BASED s3.
Test s1/s3 BULK_5000 with mixed bulk sizes and explore intermediate memory tiers using ROW and BULK combinations with s5=SET_BASED to discover finer trade-offs.
Evaluating BULK_500 for s1 with s3=ROW tests low-PGA bulk trade-offs. Also exploring s1=ROW without caching to find minimal PGA configurations.
Test combinations of low-memory ROW and SET_BASED across s1/s3 with s5=SET_BASED, exploring the low-memory boundary under 2300KB where PGA is minimized.

Test full SET_BASED conversion across all loops to establish the extreme low-buffer-gets boundary, alongside intermediate BULK options combined with cache lookups to explore memory versus I/O trade-offs.
Test combination of SET_BASED for s1/s3 while evaluating s5 variants and selective cache/bulk combinations to bridge low memory (eval 2) and extremely low gets (eval 3).

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces logical reads at the cost of PGA. Testing configurations where only one loop uses caching or pairing SET_BASED with caching explores intermediate trade-offs on the Pareto front.
Combine LOOKUP_CACHE at s2/s4 with BULK_5000 and SET_BASED at s5 to minimize f1, while also testing ROW loops with LOOKUP_CACHE to explore lower-PGA frontiers under cached lookups.
LOOKUP_CACHE achieves massive f1 savings on s1 and s3, but s1=BULK + s3=BULK dominates. Testing BULK variations, especially s1=BULK_5000/BULK_500 pairings with SET_BASED s5, finds the lowest f1 knee.
Test caching only s2 or s4 with SET_BASED or BULK to explore intermediate memory regimes between 2.3MB and 15MB PGA, which is completely empty.
Test single-cache configurations (s2 cache vs s4 cache) paired with SET_BASED or lower batch sizes to check if PGA overhead drops substantially while keeping consistent gets moderate.
Evaluating BULK_5000 on s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE and exploring LOOKUP_SQL with small BULK limits to probe intermediate memory and I/O trade-offs near the Pareto front.
Test BULK_5000 on s1 paired with intermediate bulk sizes on s3 and explore BULK_5000 on s3 with BULK_5000 on s1 to push absolute minimum f1 reads with LOOKUP_CACHE.
Test caching only s4 with SET_BASED s1 and BULK s3 to probe memory/gets balance around 15MB PGA.
